name: accordion-32
description: Careers page listing open roles that expand into a summary and an apply button.

files.content:
import { ArrowUpRightIcon, ChevronDownIcon, MapPinIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/accordion" import { Badge } from "@workspace/ui/components/badge" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" const roles = [ { value: "pd", title: "Senior Product Designer", team: "Design", location: "Remote, Europe", type: "Full-time", summary: "Own the end-to-end experience of our invoicing product, from discovery to polished UI.", }, { value: "fe", title: "Frontend Engineer", team: "Engineering", location: "Lisbon", type: "Full-time", summary: "Build fast, accessible interfaces in React and help shape our component library.", }, { value: "cs", title: "Customer Success Lead", team: "Operations", location: "Remote, US", type: "Contract", summary: "Guide new customers through onboarding and turn their feedback into product insight.", }, ] export default function AccordionJobOpenings() { return ( {roles.map((role) => ( {role.title} {role.location} · {role.team} {role.type}

{role.summary}

 ))} ) }
